author: FoeSure
quote: I would have rather spend the money from buying this game on previous titles and replay them with much greater joy. Incompetent team of developers/writers. I don't even care about graphics, all you had to do is deliver player an amazing story and new world to explore, with those two parameters you would never get so much hate even if you have reused same assets and same engine. Complete and utter dissapointment, will never trust this franchise ever again for any of their content, either bring old devs back again, which I doubt they'd agree to, or just enjoy your last few days of success while choosing new gravestone for your corporate logo.
